data.content:
* * *

## [VERY DIFFICULT to get in touch with](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6696cf52cadb37befd39b000)
I ordered several items from Lulu and Georgia, a bed, a rug with pad and a coffee table. After placing my order on 6/11/24 I got an estimated delivery date for the bed 2-4 weeks from the order date and 8/5-8/19 for the coffee table. There was no delivery date for the ru although the rug pad I ordered came within the week. I have emailed customer service to both the trade department (I am an interior designer) and the regular customer service email a week ago (said they would respon within 48 hrs) and then again 48 hours after that and then again yesterday to both email addresses. I have yet to reeive a response.

July 16, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 17, 2024

Hi Karen,

Thank you for reaching out and sharing your experience. We're truly disappointed to hear about the delay in our response.

We've sent a request through Trustpilot to gather more details so we can escalate this to our Customer Experience team and resolve the issue promptly.
